text: Your child imitates you: if you are on the phone all the time, he will want to do the same. Be the role model—keep the phone in a drawer during playtime, mealtime, and bedtime. Your attention to him is more precious than any app.

review_defects.why: The Arabic common word «القدوة» is transliterated as 'qudwah' though it is not in the app's allowed transliteration list; the gloss '(role model)' is provided so meaning is intact.
